_comment: Models the router (scripts/route-worker.mjs) may pick for a WORKER. Edit freely.
tier: 1 local, 2 free/cheap cloud, 3 strong, 4 frontier. The router takes the lowest tier that
is >= the change's minimum (size S/M/L/XL -> 1/2/3/4; high risk -> 3; visual -> 3 + visual:true).
cost: local | free | sub (subscription, quota-limited) | metered (pay per token) - cheaper first.
quotas: usage keys that must stay above quota_floor_pct (claude_5h/claude_weekly from the Claude
statusline, gemini_5h/gemini_weekly/agy3p_* from Antigravity, codex_5h/codex_weekly from ~/.codex,
openrouter_free from OpenRouter /api/v1/key). health_match: provider name in overload errors -
breaker_threshold such errors in the last hour take the model out of rotation for that hour.
visual: true = trusted with SVG/CSS/canvas/sprites/UI art (owner: Opus 5.5 or gpt-6-astra).
preference: small +/- nudge within the same tier and cost (lower = preferred).
openai-codex/* = GPT models on the Codex Plus subscription (pi's ChatGPT login); usage % is read via
chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage. openai/* = the metered API key - disabled.
score_name: the model's public name for the Scores view (scripts/model-scores.mjs), when the id does not say it.
opencodego_5h/weekly/monthly: OpenCode Go plan usage (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage, key in ~/.harness/config/opencode-go.key or pi's opencode-go login).
context_window: tokens, from pi's own model table - used for the sidebar's ctx % (scripts/usage-meters.mjs).

visual_min_design: Open Design Arena score that makes a model visual-capable without visual:true. change_tokens: rough tokens per change size, checked against the plan's allowance (Real API Pricing). pricing_plans: which plan each provider bills through.
backends: agent tools that can run a model, tried in backend_priority order (opencode before pi); backend_weight adds to the cost of picking that backend (negative = preferred).

tier_for: {"<risk>:<size>": tier} - the model counts as that tier for that kind of change only. visual_fallback_penalty (default 12): for visual work, a model that is not visual:true (it only qualifies by design score) comes after the owner's visual models.

min_tier_by_risk: sets the minimum tier per risk and size (owner: low/medium-risk L starts at tier 2). free_first: for these risks and sizes, without visuals and before any struggle, free/local models get `bonus` points off so they lead; 2 change requests or failed qualifications move the change up a tier and switch it off. wait_for_reset_hours: when nothing is usable at the needed tier, the strongest OTHER agent takes it (never below tier 3 for high risk / visual); only when no agent at all can, wait for a quota that resets within this many hours.
